```python import re import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.fourtube import FourTubeBaseIE class DummyFourTubeIE(FourTubeBaseIE): # Simplified patterns for testing _VALID_URL = r'https?://example\.com/(?P\w+)(?:/(?P[\w-]+))?' _URL_TEMPLATE = 'https://example.com/%s' _TKN_HOST = 'token.example.com' def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs): super().__init__(*args, **kwargs) # Store calls for verification self._download_json_calls = [] self._download_webpage_calls = [] def _download_json(self, url, video_id, data=None, headers=None): self._download_json_calls.append((url, video_id, data, headers)) # Return a predictable token dict return {'1080': 'https://cdn.example.com/1080p.mp4', '720': 'https://cdn.example.com/720p.mp4', '480': 'https://cdn.example.com/480p.mp4'} def _download_webpage(self, url, video_id, note=None, errnote=None, headers=None, data=None, timeout=10, err=None): self._download_webpage_calls.append((url, video_id, note, errnote, headers, data, timeout, err)) # Return a minimal HTML containing required meta tags return f""" abc123 Channel Name
  • Tag1
  • Tag2
""" def test_extract_formats_returns_expected_list(tmp_path): """Test that _extract_formats returns a list of format dicts with correct fields.""" ie = DummyFourTubeIE() url = 'https://example.com/abc' video_id = 'abc' media_id = '999' sources = ['1080', '720', '480'] formats = ie._extract_formats(url, video_id, media_id, sources) # Verify that the returned list has the same length as sources assert len(formats) == len(sources) # Verify each format dict contains expected keys and values for fmt, quality in zip(formats, sources): assert fmt['format_id'] == f'{quality}p' assert fmt['resolution'] == f'{quality}p' assert fmt['quality'] == int(quality) assert fmt['url'] == f'https://cdn.example.com/{quality}p.mp4' def test_real_extract_parses_expected_fields(tmp_path): """Test that _real_extract parses title, timestamp, thumbnail, uploader, etc.""" ie = DummyFourTubeIE() # URL that matches _VALID_URL and includes display_id url = 'https://example.com/abc/abc-display' result = ie._real_extract(url) # Basic fields assert result['id'] == 'abc' assert result['title'] == 'Test Video' assert result['thumbnail'] == 'https://example.com/thumb.jpg' assert result['uploader'] == 'Channel Name' assert result['uploader_id'] == 'abc123' assert result['categories'] == ['Tag1', 'Tag2'] assert result['view_count'] == 1234 assert result['like_count'] == 56 assert result['duration'] == 90 # 1 minute 30 seconds assert result['age_limit'] == 18 # Formats should be present and non-empty assert isinstance(result['formats'], list) assert len(result['formats']) == 3 # Check that the first format is 1080p assert result['formats'][0]['format_id'] == '1080p' def test_real_extract_raises_on_invalid_url(): """Test that _real_extract raises ExtractorError when URL does not match pattern.""" ie = DummyFourTubeIE() invalid_url = 'https://invalid.com/notmatching' with pytest.raises(Exception) as excinfo: ie._real_extract(invalid_url) # The exception should indicate a URL mismatch assert 'does not match' in str(excinfo.value) or 'Invalid URL' in str(excinfo.value) ```
